title: Content inspected in and out, with a graduated answer
lede: Every request and every response passes the inspection. A policy turns scores into allow, alert, sanitize or block, and every result is recorded in Agent Insights. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: MCP server, LLM or peer agent

steps.title: Content arrives
steps.what: A prompt, a tool result, a retrieved document or a peer agent's message reaches the gateway. Where it came from (its role) matters: content the user never typed is scored higher.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.what: The gateway hands the content to the inspection: built-in categories, the personal-data kinds you selected and the secret detectors.

steps.title: Your rules
steps.what: Pasted gitleaks-format rules run in a worker thread with a hard time limit, never in the server's own thread.

steps.title: Matches
steps.what: The worker returns offsets only. The values stay in the engine and are masked everywhere else.

steps.title: A graduated answer
steps.what: Scores meet per-category thresholds (with per-key and per-application overrides): allow, alert, sanitize or block.

steps.title: Forward
steps.what: Allow and alert pass the content on; sanitize forwards it with the offending span redacted; block withholds it.

steps.title: The way back
steps.what: The response is inspected too, so data cannot leave through the answer. A streamed response is inspected frame by frame.

steps.title: Record
steps.what: Every result goes to Agent Insights with the category, the rule, the direction, the decision, and the agent and person behind it.
